p.src: The third tool is recovery. The speaker names hobbies and passions outside work: going to the gym, doing something physical, going to dinner with friends, bowling, reading in a hammock, or playing video games. The point is not that every leisure activity has the same effect. He distinguishes genuinely enjoyable, refreshing activity from simply drifting on social media all night.
